resources.string: Android warns that keyboards may collect what you type. Monkey\'s Paw is a prompt picker, with no letter keys. It inserts your prompts and does not read text from other apps. It reads the clipboard only when you choose a prompt that uses it. Enable Monkey\'s Paw picker in the keyboard settings.
The picker keyboard is not enabled.
Could not check whether the picker keyboard is enabled.
Choose Monkey\'s Paw picker in the system list. You can switch back with the keyboard button in the navigation bar. Check status after you close the list.
Could not check which keyboard is selected.
The Insert prompt tile opens a prompt to fill and copy. Paste the result in your app.
Choose Add tile to open the system request.
Swipe down twice to open Quick Settings, choose Edit (the pencil or menu), then drag Insert prompt into your active tiles. The edit control depends on your device.
The system reported that the tile was already added.
The tile was not added. You can skip this step or try again yourself.
Could not add the tile. You can add Insert prompt from Quick Settings → Edit, or skip this step.
Could not read setup progress. Try again.
Could not save your choice. This step is kept. Try again to save it.
Could not open keyboard settings. Open your device settings and find the keyboard list, or skip this step.
Could not open the keyboard list. Use the keyboard button in the navigation bar, or skip this step.
